items.title: Singing in church
items.text: His mother and his aunt are lifelong gospel singers. He started singing in church at two.

items.title: Sam Cooke at the NAACP Freedom Fund gala
items.text: He sang on stage at the awards gala in New York.

items.title: “Feeling Good” opens a Jay-Z video
items.text: His Nina Simone cover went viral and was sampled at the start of the video for “4:44.”

items.title: *Little Big Shots*, twice
items.text: “For Every Mountain” on the season three premiere, then “O Holy Night” on the NBC holiday special.

items.title: *The View* with Yolanda Adams
items.text: “Never Give Up,” live, for MLK Day.

items.title: On tour with H.E.R.
items.text: He toured with H.E.R., then went home to finish high school.

items.title: “This Ain’t It”
items.text: His debut single. He directed the music video himself.

items.title: Sammie Moore in *Sinners*
items.text: His first film role, opposite Michael B. Jordan, in Ryan Coogler’s film. He learned guitar for the part. In July he released “Somethin.”

items.title: The Oscars, and Columbia Records
items.text: Nominated for the BAFTA EE Rising Star Award. Best Young Performer at the Critics’ Choice Awards. “I Lied to You” live at the 98th Academy Awards. Signed with Columbia in March, then “Don’t Hate Me” and “Lean On.”

items.title: “Lean On” is out
items.text: No new film or TV role has been announced.
